text:
sara (eng-platform): Heads-up — product wants a dashboard for Private/VPC deployments that shows runtime metrics (latency, batch size, queue time), infra signals (GPU util, memory, disk), and export health (agent backlog, last-success). Need to coordinate agent/network/KMS requirements.

jia (eng-infra): I think agent-based push is simplest for customers. Agent opens only outbound TLS to our collector. That avoids opening inbound.

sara (eng-platform): Agreed. Can we keep it to 443 only? Customers hate wide firewall changes. :thumbsup:

jia (eng-infra): Prefer 443 but need mTLS for tenant auth. We'll issue client certs per deployment. Also recommend an optional proxy mode for air-gapped installs (local aggregator).

omar (eng-security): For keys: customers want CMK/HSM support. We should do envelope encryption where agent encrypts with ephemeral key, wrapped by customer CMK in their KMS. Audit logs must show key unwrap events.

matt (product): From dashboard POV we need: per-tenant p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, average batch size, KV cache hit rate, queue length, gpu_util, host_p99_syscall_latency, and export_backlog_seconds. Also uptime and last_success for export.

ellie (eng-sre): Two operational notes: 1) we must support DNS allowlist because many customers only allow hostnames. 2) Provide an IP-range fallback for orgs that only allow IPs — but those ranges must be documented and gated per-region.

jia (eng-infra): We'll publish region-specific egress IP blocks + FQDNs. But note: CDNs can change IPs; we should recommend FQDN+TLS+SNI validation as default. For strict IP-only shops enable static egress via NAT GW we control in the hosted collector vpc.

omar (eng-security): Audit log hook: agent should emit signed audit events to a local file and optionally forward them encrypted to our audit collector. Customers must be able to point to their own KMS for wrapping. Also include an HSM mode for on-prem HSMs.

sara (eng-platform): Need a concrete schema for metrics so console teams can build dashboards. Minimal fields: timestamp, tenant_id (hashed), metric_name, value, sample_rate, seq_id, node_id, schema_version. No PII.

matt (product): Hashing tenant_id is fine, but we need stable pseudonymous id to join runtime traces with usage tables. Use HMAC with customer salt?

omar (eng-security): Yes HMAC with customer-managed salt works. Document threat model and retention policy.

jia (eng-infra): Agent config example (will publish as part of docs):

```yaml
agent: 
  mode: push
  collector: metrics.redwood.example.com:443
  mtls: true
  cert_path: /etc/redwood/certs/client.pem
  metrics_batch_size: 512
  heartbeat_interval_s: 30
  local_archive: /var/lib/redwood/metrics-archive
  encryption: envelope
  kms_wrap_key: projects/foo/locations/us/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key
```

ellie (eng-sre): One more: sampling defaults — send 100% of errors/latency spikes, 10% of normal token-level events by default. Allow customers to override.

sara (eng-platform): For console UX: show which fields are sampled and sampling rate, export last-success timestamp, and clear guidance on firewall instructions (FQDN + fallback IP blocks + NAT option).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: registry image redwood/metrics-agent:v0.8.1 pushed to dockerhub. Deployment PR: https://git.internal/redwood/metrics-agent/pull/412 :rocket:

jia (eng-infra): We'll add a config flag `egress_mode` {fqdn, static_ips, private_s3} — private_s3 allows agent to write to a customer S3-compatible endpoint (VPC endpoint) encrypted, then we pull. Useful for very locked-down networks.

matt (product): UX question: how will customer enable exports in Private? Console toggle + key upload flow?

sara (eng-platform): Propose console: onboarding wizard that requests `egress_mode`, optional CMK ARN, and cert CSR upload. Provide a YAML agent manifest they can `kubectl apply` or systemd unit.

omar (eng-security): Need legal sign-off on logging retention and schema. I'll loop in compliance. Also ensure agent binary signed and reproducible build.

jia (eng-infra): Action items: 1) infra: publish IP blocks + FQDN docs 2) platform: finalize schema & onboarding flow 3) security: KMS/HSM playbook + audit spec 4) sre: sampling defaults + runbook. I'll open infra tickets.

sara (eng-platform): Great. Can each owner drop estimated ETA in this thread? We want an internal beta in ~4 weeks. :eyes:

jia (eng-infra): ETA: infra docs + egress IPs by 2w.

omar (eng-security): ETA: KMS/HSM spec + audit log draft 3w.

ellie (eng-sre): ETA: sampling/runbook + alert rules 3w.

matt (product): ETA: dashboard mocks + onboarding wizard copy 2.5w.

sara (eng-platform): Thanks — I'll create the schema PR this afternoon and link. :thumbsup:
